correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, rank-comparison probabilities yield covariance 1/12 when an inversion pair is internal to a decreasing triple, and 0,+/-1/24 for a one-index overlap. Summing the exact configurations proves Cov(D_i,T)=((n-2)(n-1)(n+1))/48-((n-3)(i-1)(n-i))/24, positivity and center-minimum. The same three-point probabilities prove Var(D_i)=[2(n-1)+(n-2i+1)^2]/12. A direct bounded projection argument yields Var(T)=(13/7200)n^5+O(n^4), a published independently known constant; combining gives the asserted central-width sqrt(n) correlation profile and off-window vanishing. The packaged standard-library verifier exhaustively checks all permutations n=3..8 and recomputes the variance coefficient using exact rational integration. These finite checks corroborate rather than replace the all-n proof.

value.rationale: Marked inversion participation and global monotone-triple count are natural, jointly observable random-permutation statistics. The exact finite polynomial reveals strongest raw covariance at the ends, whereas normalized correlation remains macroscopic only in the central O(sqrt(n)) window. The explicit continuous limiting profile, with peak (5/4)sqrt(3/13), pinpoints a nontrivial dependence scale not supplied by either marginal theory. This is a substantive structural fluctuation law, not a renaming of the known triple variance.
